content.title: Justin Bieber's 16-Month-Old Son Jack Blues Is 'Just Like Daddy,' Says Mom Hailey Bieber
content.text: The Rhode founder shared a sweet snap of her husband, Justin and their son, Jack Blues on Monday, Jan 19 Updated on January 20, 2026 09:40PM EST Justin Bieber, Jack Blues Bieber, Hailey Bieber. Credit : Hailey Bieber/Instagram NEED TO KNOW On Monday, Jan 19, Rhode founder Hailey Bieber shared a sweet image of her husband, Justin Bieber, cuddling their son, 16-month-old Jack Blues Bieber"Just like Daddy," she captioned the family photographJustin, 31, and Hailey, 28, welcomed their son Jack in August 2024 Justin Bieber’s son Jack Blues is a chip off the old block! On Monday, Jan 19, Justin’s wife, Hailey Baldwin Bieber, 29, shared a sweet snap to her Instagram Stories of 31-year-old Justin holding onto his blonde-haired boy. In the image, shirtless Justin is displaying his tattooed chest as he sweetly cradles his son. “Just like Daddy,” Hailey captioned the image. Earlier in the month, Hailey kicked off the new year by sharing a carousel of photographs on Instagram, which offered a glimpse of Jack Blues, whom she and the “Baby” singer welcomed in August 2024. Justin Bieber and Jack Blues Bieber. Justin Bieber/Instagram One of the images showed Jack’s fair hair spiked up, while another depicted the anklet she wears bearing her boy’s name. And back in December, the Bieber family donned matching plaid pajamas to celebrate the Christmas holidays. "Merry Christmas ❤️❤️," Hailey captioned her twinning Instagram Story, marking her second Christmas as a mom. The image showed Hailey smiling at her little boy as he threw his arms up in the air. Related Stories Justin also shared a loved-up photo of himself and Hailey bundled up in puffer coats and scarves on Instagram on Dec. 25, writing, "MERRY CHRISTMAS FROM THE BIEBERS 🫂🎅❤️, alongside. Hailey and Justin got engaged in 2018 and later that same year, the couple got married in a civil ceremony in New York City. They then celebrated their union with a larger ceremony a year later, surrounded by over 150 family and friends. In August 2024, they became parents. Hailey Bieber holds her son Jack Blues Bieber in April 2025. Hailey Bieber/ Instagram Never miss a story — sign up for PEOPLE's free daily newsletter to stay up-to-date on the best of what PEOPLE has to offer​​, from celebrity news to compelling human interest stories. Earlier this year, Hailey and Justin celebrated their seventh wedding anniversary with a source telling PEOPLE that “becoming parents” and overcoming the “challenges” they’ve faced have only strengthened their bond and their marriage. The insider said, "They've had challenges like anyone else, but they always come back to the same thing: They truly believe they are soulmates." “Jack is the center of everything for them," the source added.
